title: CLI 0.4.1: Built for AI Agents
summary: New info, view, diff and mcp init commands, blocks by name without prompts, dry runs and JSON output, so scripts and AI agents can drive the whole CLI.
body:
- [**`ui-thing info`**](/getting-started/cli#info): shows your setup in one call (Nuxt, TypeScript and Tailwind versions, package manager, folders, installed components and registry items, Nuxt modules) plus warnings for known problems.
- [**`ui-thing block <names> --yes`**](/getting-started/cli#block): add blocks by name without prompts. It installs the components and npm packages the blocks use and prints the tag to use. Browse with `--list` or `--json`.
- [**`ui-thing view`**](/getting-started/cli#view): see a component's, block's or registry item's source and dependencies without installing it.
- [**`ui-thing diff`**](/getting-started/cli#diff) and **`update --dry-run`**: compare your copies with the latest version before updating.
- [**`add --dry-run`**](/getting-started/cli#add): list the files, packages and Nuxt modules `add` would change.
- [**`ui-thing mcp init`**](/getting-started/cli#mcp): connect Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code to the [UI Thing MCP server](/getting-started/mcp) with one command.
- **JSON everywhere**: `info`, `list`, `view`, `diff`, `block --list`, `registry list/search` and the dry runs print JSON with `--json`.
- **No prompts**: `prettier --yes` and `shortcuts` no longer ask anything.
- **Fixes**: `add` installs packages before registering Nuxt modules (fixes `datepicker` and `calendar` in projects that run `nuxt prepare` on install), resolves the full dependency tree, installs packages a component imports but forgot to declare, and works with pnpm 11+ when it skips build scripts.
